headline: 46 dead as two children swept away in Cox's Bazar floods
summary: A 19-month-old baby was found dead and a 12-year-old boy remains missing after being swept away by floodwaters in Pekua and Chakaria.
details: Two children were swept away by floodwaters in the Chakaria and Pekua upazilas of Cox's Bazar on Saturday.
In Chakaria's Kaiyarbill Union, 12-year-old Sujit Das went missing after being swept into a fish pond while walking home with two others along a rural road.

caption:
A 19-month-old baby dead and a 12-year-old boy missing. The flood toll in Cox's Bazar has hit 46.

Two children were swept away by floodwaters in the Chakaria and Pekua upazilas of Cox's Bazar on Saturday.

In Chakaria's Kaiyarbill Union, 12-year-old Sujit Das went missing after being swept into a fish pond while walking home with two others along a rural road.

Fire service officials stated that rescue operations were hindered by strong currents and the absence of a diving team on-site, though a team from Chattogram has been notified.

In Pekua's Sadar Union, 19-month-old Mushfiqur Rahim was found dead by his uncle after being swept away from his home, where water levels had reached waist-height in the courtyard.

A doctor officially declared the baby dead upon arrival at the hospital, a fact confirmed by Pekua Upazila Nirbahi Officer Rফিকুল Islam.

The total death toll from recent floods, flash floods, and landslides in the region has now climbed to 46.

headline: Samanzar Sayeed crowned Miss World Bangladesh 2026
summary: The winner will represent Bangladesh at the 75th Miss World Festival in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, starting August 9.
details: Samanzar Sayeed has been crowned Miss World Bangladesh 2026 at a grand finale held at the Mallika Hall of Radisson Blu Dhaka Water Garden.
She will now represent Bangladesh at the 75th Miss World Festival in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with the grand finale scheduled for September 5.
Swagata Saha Oishi was named the first runner-up, while Labiba Manzur finished as the second runner-up in the competition.
Azra Mahmood, National Director of Miss World Bangladesh, stated that the organization's vision is to empower young people through modelling and presenting.
The judging panel included industry experts and former titleholders, including Miss Universe Bangladesh 2019 Shirin Akhter Sheela and Miss World Bangladesh 2019 Rafah Nanjeba Torsa.
Other judges included textile specialist Sheikh Saifur Rahman, Star Lifestyle Editor Mehrin Afroze Chowdhury, and Miss International Bangladesh 2024 Efa Tabassum.
caption:
Bangladesh has a new queen! Samanzar Sayeed is crowned Miss World Bangladesh 2026.

Samanzar Sayeed has been crowned Miss World Bangladesh 2026 at a grand finale held at the Mallika Hall of Radisson Blu Dhaka Water Garden.

She will now represent Bangladesh at the 75th Miss World Festival in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with the grand finale scheduled for September 5.

Swagata Saha Oishi was named the first runner-up, while Labiba Manzur finished as the second runner-up in the competition.

Azra Mahmood, National Director of Miss World Bangladesh, stated that the organization's vision is to empower young people through modelling and presenting.

The judging panel included industry experts and former titleholders, including Miss Universe Bangladesh 2019 Shirin Akhter Sheela and Miss World Bangladesh 2019 Rafah Nanjeba Torsa.

Other judges included textile specialist Sheikh Saifur Rahman, Star Lifestyle Editor Mehrin Afroze Chowdhury, and Miss International Bangladesh 2024 Efa Tabassum.
